scenarios.title: Runway night
scenarios.summary: Host a walk in your world: guests come through the gate, your agent greets them and sells the looks they see.

steps.label: Your host
steps.hint: The host the night runs through

steps.label: Gate pass
steps.hint: What guests pay at the door, in EGG

steps.label: Customer agent
steps.hint: Greets and sells at the door

greeting.Warm: Welcome in, {name}. {host} saved you a seat; the {look} walks last tonight.
greeting.Bold: {name}, you made it. Front row at {host}. Watch for the {look}.
greeting.Playful: Psst, {name}: the {look} is the surprise. Gate is {gate}, the fun is free.
greeting.Luxe: Good evening, {name}. Your place at {host} is ready; the {look} is yours to try.
greeting.Mysterious: {name}. The lights drop at nine. Ask for the {look}.

scenarios.title: Pop-up shop
scenarios.summary: Build on a plot of land, stock a look in the window, and let a SUM machine compound the takings.

greeting.Warm: Hello {name}, welcome to the shop. The {look} in the window is one of three.
greeting.Bold: {name}! The {look} is in. Try it before it is gone.
greeting.Playful: Come in, {name}, we only bite on Fridays. The {look} is calling.
greeting.Luxe: {name}, a private fitting is ready. Shall we start with the {look}?

scenarios.title: Watch party
scenarios.summary: Screen a title you are cast in; the looks worn on screen are for sale as it plays.

greeting.Warm: Grab a seat, {name}. {title} starts in five; the {look} shows up in the second act.
greeting.Bold: {name}, it is {title} night. Do not blink when the {look} walks in.
greeting.Playful: Popcorn, {name}? {title} is on, and yes, you can buy the {look} mid-scene.
greeting.Luxe: {name}, your screening of {title} is ready. The {look} is available on request.

scenarios.title: Resale loop
scenarios.summary: Swap PFTs up the ladder; the pool pays the differences and a SUM compounds them until your withdraw limit.

greeting.Warm: Hi {name}, I found three swaps for your {look}.
greeting.Bold: {name}, your {look} is worth more today. Swap now?

scenarios.title: Fan club
scenarios.summary: Sell earnings shares in your host to fans, greet each new holder and send them a welcome look.

greeting.Warm: Welcome to the club, {name}. Your share of {host} starts today, and the {look} is on its way.
greeting.Bold: {name}, you own a piece of {host} now. Act like it.
greeting.Playful: Ding! {name} joined {host}. The {look} is your welcome gift.
greeting.Luxe: {name}, thank you for joining {host}. The {look} has been reserved for you.
greeting.Mysterious: {name}. You are one of us now. Look for the {look}.

scenarios.title: Profile drop
scenarios.summary: Put your profile PFT to work: fans follow it into a host, through a gate.

greeting.Warm: Hi {name}, it is me, {pfp}. Come say hello at {host}.
greeting.Playful: {name}! {pfp} here. The gate at {host} is open.
